# Repository documentation rules

- Keep `README.md` and `CODE-MAP.md` aligned with the three-file static runtime.
- Comment provider API/stream contracts, browser storage/secret lifetime, PDF extraction, ATS heuristic assumptions and non-obvious export behaviour.
- Do not add comments that merely narrate DOM assignment or CSS syntax.
- Preserve the rule that generated application documents may not invent candidate facts not present in the source resume.
- Keep API keys session-scoped and out of committed/static source.
- Describe the ATS percentage as a local lexical heuristic, not a vendor-certified score.
- Do not claim provider/model availability or runtime verification without checking it.
